selection.policy: reference-only external evidence; native Rust remains the product path
selection.reason: Trivy is present locally, emits machine-readable output, can scan the repository-local IaC fixture without credentials, and can skip check updates; the adapter remains optional and does not ship the engine.

testEvidence.genericAdapter: cargo test --locked -p enforcer-harness --test cyberskills_adapters -- --nocapture: prior contract remains green
testEvidence.live: with OCENTRA_TRIVY_EXECUTABLE set to the observed binary, live output normalized and matched the recorded first finding; without that override, the bounded runner reports its spawn failure as Errored, never Pass
negativeCases: non-zero, timeout, and output overflow -> Errored
clean output -> Ran with zero findings
arbitrary parser input -> deterministic acceptance result across repeated passes

proves: CP07 has one bounded Trivy reference adapter using the existing Rust execution and outcome seam
recorded Trivy JSON, clean output, malformed output, unknown severity, missing, non-zero, timeout, and output-limit behavior have explicit tests
the optional live path is honest and does not require the engine for deterministic recorded CI
the graph can record CP07 evidence without promoting external evidence into native implementation or executable proof
doesNotProve: Trivy correctness, rule-database freshness, complete methodology, or universal live availability
native implementation of the underlying CyberSkills intents or executable security proof
user installation or purchase of Trivy; the adapter is optional reference evidence only
remediation, attribution, detection efficacy, or security outcomes
protected fileless-malware source, which remains excluded and untouched
overall CyberSkills parity or overall plan completion
